User.title: User
User.description: User profile with their avatar, points, subscription plan, tactical board and game progress.

password.description: Optional encrypted or plain-text password for custom login

avatar.description: Direct indicator or emoji representing current avatar

avatarConfig.description: Custom configuration mapping for Hair, Face, Uniform, and Accessories

subscription.description: Active subscription tier: Ninguna, Plan Scout Básico, Pase VIP Elite

score.description: Total accumulated tactical and album score points

aciertosOnce.description: Number of correct tactical alignment picks

aciertosMarcador.description: Number of exact match score prediction picks

cashBalance.description: Virtual Ecuadorian simulated wallet cash balance

unlockedLevels.description: Mapping of country name to unlocked levels (e.g. { Ecuador: { '1': true, '2': true, '3': true } })

completedCountries.description: List of countries where all 26 stickers have been gathered

tacticalBoards.description: Dynamic mapping of country tactical formations and predictions

role.description: Administrative authorization level: user or admin

referredByEmail.description: Email of user who invited this player

invitedEmails.description: List of emails this user has recommended

CustomStickers.title: CustomStickers
CustomStickers.description: Administrative overrides for player stickers generated dynamically with fal.ai

imageUrl.description: Direct fal.ai or proxy image URL

CustomMatches.title: CustomMatches
CustomMatches.description: Administrative match results overrides with actual goals and status

BlogPosts.title: BlogPosts
BlogPosts.description: Dynamic blog and football news displayed on page footers

Suggestions.title: Suggestions
Suggestions.description: User suggestions and contact logs sent to administration

CustomSubscriptionCodes.title: CustomSubscriptionCodes
CustomSubscriptionCodes.description: Serial codes generated by administrators to activate paid subscriptions

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles and tactile album settings. Reads/writes are authorized based on uid ownership or admin role.

/customStickers/{playerId}.description: Admin sticker overrides. Publicly readable, writeable only by admins.

/customMatches/{matchId}.description: Admin match overrides. Publicly readable, writeable only by admins.

/blogPosts/{postId}.description: Admin blog posts. Publicly readable, writeable only by admins.

/suggestions/{suggestionId}.description: User feedback. Publicly writeable (anyone can suggest), read/write restricted to admins.

/customSubscriptionCodes/{codeId}.description: Unused/Used promotion serial codes. Writeable only by admins, readable by logged in users for activation validations.
